steps.say: Every DreamDEX bot bets without saying how confident it is. Drimer logs a probability on every window, whether it trades or not.
You can't tell if an edge is real, or just profit and loss noise, until you check it against reality.
Drag the market odds up, and the Bayesian posterior recalculates right here in the browser.
Add positive spot drift, and the edge widens. This is the exact math the orchestrator runs live every two minutes.
One click copies a real MCP call. Any other agent can ask Drimer to audit its own signal.
This is not mock data. Drimer just placed and filled a real order on live Somnia Shannon testnet.
Every prediction gets logged, so the reliability diagram can't be cherry-picked. The economic realization panel proves calibration pays, with realized return on investment, not just a claim.
Drimer: the calibration layer for DreamDEX event contracts. Live now at drimer-umber.vercel.app.
